1 وَكَزَهُ , (S, Msb,) aor. يَكِزُهُ, (Msb,) inf. n. وَكْزٌ, (Msb, K,) He struck, or beat him, (S, Msb,) [with anything,] as, for ex., with a staff, or stick: (TA:) or it signifies, (Msb,) or signifies also (S) he struck, or beat, him with his fist upon his chin: (S, Msb:) or, accord. to Ks, i. q. لَكَمَهُ; (Msb;) [i. e.] he struck, or beat, him with his fist. (A, K.) ―
-b2- He pushed, or impelled, or repelled, him. (S, Msb, K.) ―
-b3- He pierced him (Ks, K, * TK) with a spear. (TK.) ―
-b4- He goaded him. (TA.) ―
-b5- He broke his nose. (T, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
